_notes: BENCHMARK PACK (packs/README.md section 7). The company is real, named openly, and everything here is public information: a benchmark whose subject is hidden is a number with no referent. It is never selected as a run's own company; it is read for STRUCTURE and for population-tagged ranges. Every figure lives in facts.md carrying one of the three permitted source-class descriptors plus the year that figure describes, and no address: a class ages into staleness in front of the reader, a link rots quietly. Pointers only, as with every manifest here.
name: ref-chatbase
display: Chatbase, AI customer support benchmark (public information)
industry: AI customer support, sold globally as bootstrapped self-serve SaaS
shape_note: the shape triple (vertical, market, model) is authoritative on this pack's registry row in config/packs.json, where the neighbour-matching question is asked over the index before any manifest is opened. The industry line above is the human label and never a second source of truth.
nsm_note: no north star travels with this pack: these are somebody else's counting numbers, and a run still elicits its own north-star metric at context-lock.

context_files.consult: input-readiness only. Most machines will not hold this material, and its absence is a NAMED miss at context-lock, never an error and never a machine dependency: the figures a run would read from it are already restated, tagged and dated in facts.md. A machine that does hold it keeps it here under the exact name above, with no suffix after it, so the pointer resolves as written.
any phase reading benchmark shape: the public figures, each with its source-class descriptor and the year it describes, and the strategic readings kept separate from them under hypotheses

found_sources: public information only: the tagged lines of packs/ref-chatbase/facts.md, each carrying a permitted source-class descriptor and a year, and nothing else grounds a claim under this pack.
ledger_note: a real pack names the learnings classes its history seeded so a later run consults them first; this benchmark has no run history of its own, so the class is only the consult-first hint for reads of this shape

seam.note: nothing about a benchmark company is shipped anywhere. A run that reaches a handoff seam under this pack has selected the wrong pack.

analytics.note: live-analytics capabilities are NOT selectable under this pack (injection point I5). There is no instrumented product here to probe, only public figures with a year on each of them.

deck_kit.note: no design kit exists for a benchmark company and a visual identity is never borrowed, so the deck lane is unavailable under this pack.

provenance: authored for this package as a benchmark pack.
